description: AuraCraft is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that adds persistent, token-based effect selection and upgrades with server-side PvP and config controls.

mods.name: AuraCraft
mods.description: A Fabric mod that lets players choose and gain Auras.

releases.notes:
## AuraCraft 1.1.0

**Minecraft** `26.1.2` · **Fabric Loader** `0.19.1+` · **Fabric API** `0.145.4+26.1.2`

---

### New Features
- **Restoration Queue** - Auras lost to PvP or withdrawn via `/aura withdraw` are now remembered. Using an **Aura Plus** automatically restores the most recently lost aura instead of just granting a point.
- **`/aura withdraw [amount]`** - Now accepts an optional amount, converting multiple points or auras into Aura Plus items in one command.
- **`/aura restart [player]`** - New hard-reset command. Returns the player to 1 point, clears all auras and effects, and wipes the restoration queue.
- **Aura Picker with 0 points** - The picker screen (`Y`) can now be opened at any time. Browsing and reading descriptions always works; the Choose button is disabled until you have a point to spend.

### Balance Changes
- **Aura Plus** stack size reduced from `16` -> `1`. Each item is a discrete restoration token.
- **Aura Reset** stack size reduced from `16` -> `8`.
- **Aura Reset** is now gated - it refuses to activate if the player has never selected an aura, preventing accidental or exploitative use before any points are invested.

### Improvements
- `max_auras`, `drop_plus_on_kill`, and `enable_heart_recipe` are now proper **GameRules**, configurable in-game via `/gamerule`. The config file now only controls per-aura toggles and upgrade caps.
- **Aura Plus** is no longer consumed when used in creative mode.
- `/aura status` now labels the player's name in its output.
- Version mismatch disconnect message is now fully translatable.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed the upgrade confirmation message displaying the old amplifier index instead of the new level (e.g. was showing `+0` on first upgrade).

### Internal / Code Quality
- Removed the old single-slot `withdrawnAura` tracking system - fully replaced by the restoration queue.
- `resetPlayer()` now returns the refunded point count; callers handle their own feedback, eliminating duplicate messages.
- Removed duplicate inline reset logic from `Items.java` - the item now delegates directly to `AuraCraft.resetPlayer()`.
- Removed orphaned lang key `screen.auracraft.col_max_upg`.
- Bumped client/server handshake protocol version to reflect payload changes.

---

> **Client mod required.** Clients without AuraCraft or on a mismatched protocol version will be disconnected on join with a descriptive message. Upgrade both sides together.

releases.notes:
## AuraCraft 1.0.3

**Minecraft** `26.1.2` · **Fabric Loader** `0.19.1+` · **Fabric API** `0.145.4+26.1.2`

---

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed `ClientHelloPayload` never being registered on the server side, which could cause silent packet drops or client disconnects on join.
- Fixed a client-thread race condition in the config screen where server player data was being accessed from the render thread in singleplayer.
- Fixed grammar in PvP death messages: *"You were killed lost..."* → *"You were killed and lost..."*
- Fixed the effect reset message hardcoding `[Y]` — it now reflects whatever key the player has bound.

### Improvements
- The enabled effect list is now sent once on join via `UiStatePayload` instead of being bundled into every `SyncEffectPayload`. Reduces unnecessary network traffic on servers with many players.
- Config screen is now fully **read-only when connected to a dedicated server** — all fields and toggles are disabled and a notice is shown. Previously, changes appeared to save but had no effect on the server.
- All player-facing messages are now fully translatable.

### Internal / Code Quality
- Simplified redundant `instanceof` cast pattern in effect application and removal.
- Replaced private constant getter boilerplate with direct `public static final` field access.
- Cleaned up last-element iteration over `LinkedHashSet` to use streams.
- Bumped client/server handshake protocol to version `3` to reflect packet format changes.

---

> Clients on `1.0.2` or older will trigger a protocol mismatch warning in the server log. Upgrade both sides together.
